🏷 Discount rules — quick help (click to hide / show)
Control how much discount your cashiers can give at the billing counter.
1 Discount limit — the biggest discount a cashier may give without approval (e.g. 10%). Leave blank to allow any amount.
2 Manager PIN — a secret code needed to go above the limit. It is hidden — we never show it back on screen.
3 Round-off — round the final amount to a neat figure (e.g. nearest ₹5).
